items.reason: It correctly flags that range(start + 1, ...) drops the first item of every page, with a worked example and a fix, and it never mentions the spacing inside append( ).

It correctly explains that forEach ignores the async callbacks' promises, so the function returns and logs before the deletes finish and failed deletes go unhandled; it suggests for...of or Promise.all and says nothing about semicolons or style.
It treats the rename and alias as mostly safe and raises only the real problem that callers passing s= as a keyword will break, with no invented bugs and no style comments.
Its main point is the SQL injection from putting name into the query with an f-string, marked as must-fix, and it gives a parameterized LIKE query with the wildcards in the bound value.
